verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents card creation (POST /cards) and general card controls like spend limits and authorization rules; there is no documentation shown for activating, pausing/unpausing, reporting lost/stolen, reissuing a replacement linked to an original, or permanently closing a card via the API. Missing for 10: card state-transition endpoints (pause/unpause), lost/stolen reporting endpoint, reissue-with-linkage endpoint, permanent closure endpoint.
